subject: MGDT kickoff — generalist agent checkpoint for H1
body:
Hi Jelena,

Kickoff note for the Multi-Game Decision Transformer push. The pitch upstairs: one transformer, one set of weights, trained purely offline, playing 46 Atari games at close-to-human level — and, more importantly for us, fine-tuning rapidly to new games. That fine-tuning story is the product: a generalist checkpoint plus a recipe agents-rl can hand to any team with an offline interaction log.

Milestones inside our window (03-02 to 06-22): offline data pipeline validated by 04-10, medium-scale training done by mid-May, then a large scaling run in early June so we have the model-size scaling curve for the H1 readout. The colab-style eval loader from the open-source release is our starting point for the eval harness.

Jelena — can you sketch the compute ask this month? The June run is the long pole.

Ulla
